Concepts in this composition

Living Academy (Lee Sharks, #1680): A mantle constituted by the Crimson Hexagonal Archive (2026-10-13) for a library and the program it carries: borne to the extent that critique of AI-mediated political economy is carried on there across its modes, longitudinally, at a quality and with an integration a reader can check; four dimensions (extent, longitudinality, critical quality, integration) reported separately and never averaged; criteria LC-01–LC-12. Distinct from Plato's Academy and from the Restored Academy.

Frame conversion (Lee Sharks, #1525): Re-specification of a documented outcome as a contestable claim, followed by adjudication of the substitute. The event survives in name only while every fact about it is preserved. Operates on standing rather than content, and is therefore invisible to instruments that score fact survival.

Jump measure (Lee Sharks, #1680): The comparative measure of extent in the Living Academy mantle (#1680 §1A.11): one node of a program, chosen by a declared rule, is followed from state to state of its development across ranges (domain, period of the history of mediation, epoch), dimensions (the eight critical modes) and modalities (form, unit class) until no further jump can be shown at a locus; the cells reached in that multiplicative matrix, with path, projections and frontier, are compared across programs on the same axes.

PER-F (Lee Sharks, #1525): A fourth reporting axis for the Provenance Erasure Rate, scoring frame conversion. Reported alongside and never folded into the M/C/D triple, because folding it in would permit preserved facts to offset a converted frame.

Operationally instrumented (Lee Sharks, #1528): A scoring procedure specified and in active use, not merely proposed or awaiting validation.
